summary: Classify diagnostic upload refusals without blocking later captured reports.

schema.detail: No further database or claim-schema change beyond client-diagnostics-ingestion.json.

compatibility.detail: Correction to client-diagnostics-ingestion.json: the HTTP 429 public client envelope code is rate-limited, mapped from the internal client-diagnostics-rate-limit code. The TypeScript client exposes Retry-After to the phone. Terminal validation 4xx refusals discard the sent batch without dropping concurrent capture; 401/403 retain reports and pause that client until pairing changes; 429 retains reports and honours Retry-After across relaunch.

downtime.detail: No additional restart or coordinated deployment requirement.

manual.detail: No additional manual steps beyond the re-pairing described in client-diagnostics-ingestion.json.

recovery.detail: Terminally rejected batches are intentionally discarded from the bounded local phone queue; they are not replayed.
